current_clamp_layer_a.comment: Cleaner result than AIY (no extreme-tau slow gate). Cython integrator behavior matches numpy to ~5 decimals.

f18_assessment.trigger_check: RIM has 3 USEION ca channels (cca1, unc2, egl19), all with identical READ eca + WRITE ica declarations. Symmetric — NEURON ion_style preserves user-set seg.eca = 60 mV.
f18_assessment.comment: F18 refinement (asymmetric trigger) holds under cython. Cython does not re-introduce the original misprediction.

unc2_global_assessment.auto_resolution_under_brian2: per-cell-by-default semantics — every NeuronGroup variable is per-cell
unc2_global_assessment.comment: Cython namespace handling treats each NeuronGroup eqs variable as per-cell. The GLOBAL pitfall is a NMODL artifact that Brian2 (numpy or cython) cleanly avoids.
